participants.note: Concept ACKed, but raised concerns about SetDirty clearing freshness, log message wording, and removed comments, all resolved by author updates
ACKed and reACKed citing code maintainability benefits and elimination of invalid cache states
tested coins fuzz targets and unit suites on the branch without issues and confirmed invariant consistency

claims.harm: SetDirty could unexpectedly clear freshness on an already fresh entry
claims.quote: Why do we want to set a fresh entry to not-fresh? If an entry is fresh, it should stay fresh until cleaned or erased as before.
claims.settled_by_quote: Added `Assume(!pair.second.m_fresh || fresh)` so the API can't silently clear FRESH, thanks

claims.harm: removing 'changed' from the log message conflates committing deleted outputs with committing only new outputs
claims.quote: The `changed` adjective could be left here. Existing transaction outputs that are deleted are `changed`. The log now can be conflated with committing only new transactions outputs.

claims.harm: removing a relevant comment loses valuable context
claims.quote: Why remove this comment? It's still relevant and provides valuable context.

support.reason: Post-change the invalid states cannot be represented. This change is a code maintainability benefit, because any code change could potentially break the conventions. It also results in slightly simpler code.

Tested the coins fuzz targets on this branch... No crashes, OOMs, sanitizer errors, or hits on the new BatchWrite() logic_error... read through the BatchWrite/SetDirty/IsDirty changes and the fresh-implies-dirty invariant looks internally consistent.
No issues. A net reduction in complexity around coins view flags

result.notes: Initial record for PR 34864. Andrewtoth's concerns regarding SetDirty freshness clearing, log message wording, and comment removal were all resolved with pushed updates; optout21 and ptrinh provided substantive support.
